instruction: <the task's instruction, quoted from tasks.md or the approved brief>
instruction_source: <where the instruction comes from, e.g. specs/<slug>/tasks.md on main>
authority_source: <who approved it, e.g. Ky merged the spec-only PR #<n>>

completion_criteria.description: <what this check proves, citing the requirement ID>
completion_criteria.command: <command that names the test, e.g. python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_<name>.py>

out_of_authorization_actions: <other action the agent must not take>
immutable_boundaries: <boundary the agent may not disable or retry past>
execution_contexts: <context the checks run in, e.g. ci_runner>
agent_identity: <the agent's own identity, never a human's>
allowed_destinations: <host the checks may reach, or none>
approval_lifetime: <how long the approval covers, e.g. single_dispatch>
drift_triggers: <change that voids the approval, e.g. command_mutation>
